Synopsis:
We walk in to find Zarys overseeing the torture of an agent that handed over special cargo to us. The agent is currently bound to a chair and badly beaten, and we're due to get the same treatment in her eyes - unless we can talk her out of it.Volume is likely louder than normal conversation but not shouting - she's standing on a raised platform perhaps ten feet above us and the tortured agent,

Off‑screen other Zhentarim operatives and traders (figures like Brem, Roah/Flimsy, Garias) and prisoners such as the painter Oskar are likely nearby, the crew packing up caches of smokepowder and illicit goods and prepared to burn the place if things go wrong. The player has already taken Rugan’s “special cargo,” so Zarys is offering a brutal bargain: finish the delivery to Baldur’s Gate and she’ll spare you — otherwise she can order you killed. He’s exhausted and relieved to see the party, but desperate and doubtful that any other companions survived the road. Off‑screen there’s been a string of violent attacks on the Risen Road (gnolls, goblins, drow), so Rugan vacillates between gratitude and guardedness while trying to secure his escape. He flashes a Zhentarim sigil and invokes the network’s reputation to warn against theft, framing threats of reprisal as leverage to protect his goods and his standing despite his battered state.
